data.body: Final spike (bridge fsck phantom checks) landed after the other deliverables; filed as ninth bridge child 030f-c14f-596a-4f79. Key result: three of bridge fsck's four advertised checks are permanently empty because SYNC events NEVER existed in rebar - the module was ported verbatim from the pre-rebar digital-service-orchestra plugin (extraction commit b534f47a7f) and 'if not sync_events: continue' short-circuits every ticket dir. On origin/tickets today: 39216 event files, 0 SYNC, 0 BRIDGE_ALERT. The fourth advertised check (unresolved BRIDGE_ALERT counts) was never backed by code in any commit. This independently re-derived janitor ticket 8efe (BridgeFsckOut omits binding_drift) from a different starting point. Two real gaps remain: count_unresolved_alerts is implemented but gated behind .bridge-status.json, a file with no producer anywhere in the tree or history; and bindings.json's reverse map is read but never validated for forward/reverse consistency, which would be the one bridge audit decidable fully offline with zero Jira access. Five decisions recorded on the ticket, incl. whether the never-fired BRIDGE_ALERT emitter should survive at all.
